name: Pathward Financial, Inc.
summary: Pathward Financial, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for Pathward, National Association which provides various banking products and services in the United States. It operates through three segments: Consumer, Commercial, and Corporate Services/Other. The company offers demand deposit, savings, and money market savings accounts.
